name: bm-v5-porosity-bundling
claim: The two geometric readouts the spec asks the network to REPRODUCE behave as it predicts: the simulated pore-size distribution reaches the measured corneal-EM band (72 ± 40 nm) at realistic density, but the NC1/7S-only topology cannot bundle — the protomers-per-strand distribution stays near 1 and under-shoots the 5–7 comparator, the spec-named failure of a model with no lateral- association bond.
experiment: Assemble the real LAMMPS collagen IV network at several densities, then read porosity (pore-size distribution via the maximal-inscribed-disc / distance- transform method) and bundling (protomers per laterally-associated strand, at the measured 59.5 nm cell-deposited lateral spacing) off the snapshot, and place both against the measured comparators.
result: Pore median falls with coverage (130 → 76 nm as rods rise 150 → 500) and lands in the corneal-EM band (72 ± 40 nm) at the densest network; the open mesh is realistic, and pore size is a density knob, not a universal. Bundling stays near 1 (mean 1.03 → 1.17 protomers/strand, ~82% singletons, max occasionally 5–7) — the NC1/7S topology with no lateral-association bond cannot build the 5–7 strands measured in the PFHR-9 scaffold, exactly the spec's named failure.

purpose.question: Does the v1 network reproduce the measured pore-size and bundling of a real BM?
purpose.mechanism: Porosity is set by the areal density of rods (an emergent mesh); bundling requires lateral association of 5–7 protomers into a strand, a bond the released NC1/7S model does not have (it can bundle only through 7S branching).
purpose.expected_outcome: Pore size tunable into the EM band with density; bundling under-shoots 5–7 because there is no lateral-association bond — a readout that reproduces porosity but exposes a missing connectivity mode.

key_assumptions: Pore size = diameter of the maximal empty disc inscribed in the periodic network plane.
A strand = connected component of rods within 59.5 nm (≈0.5 a) lateral spacing AND near-parallel (≤22°).
Length unit a = 114 nm (bead spacing); readouts converted to nm via a.
Same clean-room parameters and force-independent off-rate as stage 1.

variants.name: density-sweep
variants.description: Assemble at coverage rungs (150, 250, 350, 500 rods) to place pore size vs density.

readouts.name: pore_diameter

behavior_tests.name: porosity-reaches-EM-band
behavior_tests.description: The simulated pore median falls within the corneal-EM band (72 ± 40 nm) at realistic density.

behavior_tests.name: bundling-under-shoots-5-7
behavior_tests.description: The NC1/7S-only network cannot build 5–7-protomer strands — the bundling distribution stays near 1 (a spec-named failure, confirming the missing lateral-association bond).

findings.statement: Pore size scales with network density and reaches the corneal-EM band (72 ± 40 nm) at the densest sampled network (median 76 nm) — the mesh is realistic and pore size is a tunable density readout, not a free universal.

evidence.observed: median pore 130 → 108 → 120 → 76 nm as rods rise 150 → 500

expected.range: 72 ± 40 nm (corneal BM EM); 20–60 nm hydrated Matrigel

findings.explanation: Porosity is emergent from areal coverage; the comparator fixes a density.

findings.statement: The NC1/7S-only topology cannot bundle: mean strand size stays near 1 (~82% singletons), never building the 5–7-protomer strands a real scaffold shows — the spec-named failure of a model with no lateral-association bond.

evidence.observed: mean strand 1.03 → 1.17, max 5–7 occasionally, <5% of rods in 5–7 strands

findings.explanation: The released model bundles only through 7S branching; the lateral- association bond that builds strands is absent (spec: a lateral term would itself under-bundle ~2× if calibrated in vitro).
findings.next_action: add an explicit lateral-association bond (v2) and re-measure bundling

if_primary_tests_pass.implementation_status: Porosity + bundling readouts run on the real network across densities.
if_primary_tests_pass.biological_validation: Porosity reproduces the EM comparator; bundling exposes a missing connectivity mode.
pipeline_unblocks: A v2 lateral-association bond (to build 5–7 strands) and bundle-driven stiffening.

diagnose: If bundling reaches 5–7 without a lateral bond, 7S branching alone suffices — revise F2.
if_primary_tests_fail.block_downstream: Diagnostic readout study; nothing downstream is gated on it.

limitations: Bundling is inferred geometrically (lateral proximity + parallelism), not from explicit lateral bonds the model lacks.
Pore sizes depend on the chosen density; the comparator is matched at one coverage, not proven universal.
Single seed per density rung; a seed ensemble would put CIs on the pore/bundling trends.
Same LJ-unit / energy-scale caveat as stage 1 (lengths are firm via a = 114 nm; stiffness is not).

report.title: Stage v5 — porosity & bundling: the geometric readouts
report.verdict: The network reproduces the measured pore-size distribution at realistic density but cannot bundle: protomers-per-strand stays near 1, far short of the 5–7 a real BM scaffold shows. Porosity validates; bundling flags a missing lateral-association bond — the concrete v2 addition.
report.main_insight: Of the two geometric readouts the spec asks the model to reproduce, one (porosity) lands in the measured band and one (bundling) exposes a named structural gap — a clean, honest separation of what v1 captures from what it misses.

sources.note: Corneal BM pore diameter 72 ± 40 nm (low-voltage SEM) — the porosity comparator.
5–7 protomers per laterally-bundled strand in the PFHR-9 scaffold — the bundling comparator.

derived.insight: Pore size scales with network density and reaches the corneal-EM band (72 ± 40 nm) at the densest sampled network (median 76 nm) — the mesh is realistic and pore size is a tunable density readout, not a free universal.
